assessment.title: Mental Health Assessment
assessment.desc: A 15-question assessment to help you understand your current mental health level and receive personalized suggestions on what to focus on first.

stress.title: Understanding Stress & Anxiety Loops
stress.desc: Stress isn't bad. Stress helps you focus and act. Problems only arise when stress persists, isn't released, and forms anxiety–habit loops. Understanding the mechanism is the first step to breaking it.
stress.img_caption: 3 stress layers · Anxiety loops · Breaking techniques

breathing.title: Breathing Techniques
breathing.desc: Breathing is a free tool, always available, no equipment needed. 4 techniques for 4 different situations — from daily foundation to an emergency reset in 2 minutes.
breathing.img_caption: 4 techniques · Interactive timer · Choose the right situation

meditation.title: Short Meditation & Mindfulness
meditation.desc: Meditation isn't about "not thinking". It's about noticing when you've been carried away and gently returning. Each return is a rep — no perfection needed.
meditation.img_caption: 4 meditation types · Interactive timer · From 3 minutes

brain_dump.title: Brain Dump — Mental Unload
brain_dump.desc: When your mind is overloaded — too many things to remember, too much anxiety — a Brain Dump is the fastest way to clear your mental RAM and regain clarity.

journaling.title: Journaling & Mental Diary
journaling.desc: Journaling is the simplest tool to free your mind — no judgment, no need for perfection, just write down what's happening inside.

digital_detox.title: Digital Detox — Digital Rest
digital_detox.desc: The brain needs time without stimulation to recover and create. Digital detox isn't about abandoning technology — it's about reclaiming control over it.

gentle_discipline.title: Gentle Discipline
gentle_discipline.desc: Lasting discipline doesn't come from being harsh with yourself, but from kindness and self-understanding. Gentle discipline is the art of being consistent without self-punishment.

habits.title: Building Lasting Habits
habits.desc: 40% of your daily actions are automatic habits — not conscious decisions. Understanding the habit formation mechanism is the most effective way to change your life.
habits.img_caption: 66 days on average to form a habit

roadmap.title: 12-Week Peaceful Mind Roadmap
roadmap.desc: A step-by-step path to build sustainable mental health — from recognizing stress to having a complete, personalized mental toolkit.

checklist.title: Daily Mind Checklist
checklist.desc: A simple checklist to track the most important mental and health habits each day and week. Automatically saved on your device.

body_scan.title: Body Scan
body_scan.desc: Body scan is a full-body meditation — scanning each zone from head to toe. The best tool for those who struggle to sleep, have sore muscles after exercise, or hold stress without knowing it.
